axes: Unity space, metres. Origin = the city centre on the ground (city floor y = 0).

lod.note: Grid step per LOD = step x the chunk's stepFactors (edge chunks have half the detail). Skirts hang 10 m down from every chunk edge, so LOD seams show no cracks.

uv: UV0 = palette swatch (fallback). No vertex colours: the TerrainBiome shader graph reads the surface textures by world position.

surface.note: Whole map, centred on the origin; first image row = +Z edge. uv = xz / size + 0.5. Both linear (sRGB off), bilinear, clamp. Masks RGBA: R flow, G hollow, B made ground (city, roads, channel), A scree. Normal RGB = world normal * 0.5 + 0.5 (Unity axes).

biomes.note: Biome table: one row of 16 pixels per biome (terrain_biomes.row). Import sRGB off, point, no mipmaps, no compression. _BiomeIndex = row.

collider: Mesh collider from each chunk's LOD0 mesh.

backdrop.note: Far scenery out to 20 km (mountains, the canyon bending away, the megacity skyline beyond the walls). No colliders; outside the flight bounds. Hide its far edge with fog.

atmosphere.note: Suggested exponential distance fog (the previews use the same numbers): factor = 1 - exp(-(distance - start) / scale).

traffic.note: Cosmetic traffic, client only. Unity space, metres. Lanes: one per direction, right-hand traffic, points (flat x, y, z list) about 10 m apart along the lane centre. closed = a loop (the last point joins the first). Open lanes: vehicles leave at the end and come back at the start.

signals.note: Lane stops (flat list): distance along the lane (m), phase (0 or 1). The two roads at a junction have opposite phases. Cycle and green times: Unity TrafficSettings.
